generations.prompt:
Create a complete, playable, single-file HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.

Game Idea: Flappy Bird style game

User Specifications:
  - clarification_1: Easy to medium difficulty, touch controls

Requirements:
1. Embed ALL code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) in a single file
2. Use HTML5 doctype and semantic structure
3. Make it fully playable - no broken features
4. Include clear instructions or tutorial for the player
5. Add a reset/restart button
6. Keep total file size under 100KB
7. Make it responsive - works on desktop and mobile
8. Use keyboard controls or mouse clicks (clearly labeled)
9. Include visual feedback (colors, animations, sounds if appropriate)
10. Match the specifications above as closely as possible

Output: Return ONLY the complete HTML code wrapped in ```html code blocks.
No explanations, no markdown text before/after, no tool usage.
